CREATE TABLE "public"."storedImage" (
  "byteSize" int4 NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "data" bytea NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "kind" text NOT NULL,
  "mimeType" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "storedImage_kind_check_f11fda7f" CHECK ("kind" IN ('QRIS', 'PAYMENT_PROOF')),
  CONSTRAINT "stored_image_size_limit_0abf31e1" CHECK (octet_length(data) BETWEEN 1 AND 3145728)
)
